channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Oil: Physical market tightens with Persian Gulf risks – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note Oil prices have extended gains as US–Iran tensions escalate and tanker flows through the Strait of Hormuz remain under pressure. Large second-quarter inventory drawdowns and the imminent end of global SPR releases leave the market more exposed.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD tumbles to near $57 as inflation projections remain de-anchored
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades 1.33% lower to near $58.00 during the European trading session on Thursday. The white metal faces selling pressure as elevated energy prices due to renewed aggression between the United States (US) and Iran have de-anchored inflation expectations again.

item.title: British Pound remains muted as UK monthly GDP rises 0.1%, as expected
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) remains almost muted against its major currency peers after the release of the monthly United Kingdom (UK) Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data for May.

item.title: Euro: Bullish bias builds above key support against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that EUR/USD has broken above prior resistance, with rapid gains seen up to 1.1482. Intraday, the pair is seen capable of testing 1.1490 while staying below significant resistance at 1.1520.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Dollar eases to 162.00, forming a triangle pattern
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) holds marginal losses against the Japanese Yen (JPY) at Thursday’s European session opening, and approaches the 162.00 area at the time of writing. Recent price action shows a sequence of lower highs and higher lows, forming a triangle pattern.

item.title: Euro remains firm against British Pound after UK growth data
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross holds positive ground near 0.8475 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The British Pound (GBP) weakens against the Euro (EUR) following the UK economic data.

item.title: United Kingdom GDP grows by 0.1% MoM in May, as expected
item.description: The UK Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 0.1% MoM in May, following a 0.1% decline reported in April, the latest data published by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Thursday.

item.title: Indian Rupee extends decline amid elevated oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens lower against the US Dollar (USD), extending its losing streak for the third trading day on Thursday. The USD/INR pair rises to near 96.32 as elevated crude oil prices have renewed fears of higher foreign outflows.

item.title: Gold sticks to modest losses as energy-driven inflation fears revive hawkish Fed bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone through the Asian session on Wednesday and currently trades near the previous day's swing low, around the $4,030-$4,025 region.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Maintains constructive uptrend above 1.3500 despite mild losses
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades with mild losses around 1.3535 during the early European trading hours on Thursday.

item.title: Asian stocks lean lower due to tech sell-off, rising US-Iran tensions
item.description: Asian stocks face downward pressure on Thursday, delivering mixed results as a renewed sell-off in semiconductor shares dragged down the tech sector. The retreat stems from persistent investor skepticism over whether the artificial intelligence rally can sustain its current valuations.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Slips below $79.00; bullish bias persists amid US-Iran tensions
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – ticks lower during the Asian session on Thursday, though it lacks bearish conviction and remains close to an over one-month high touched earlier this week.

item.title: BoJ Quarterly Survey: 90.4% of Japanese households anticipate price increases in a year
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) quarterly survey in June showed on Thursday that 90.4% of Japanese households expect prices to rise a year from now, compared with 83.7% in the previous survey.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Euro consolidates near four-week top, above mid-1.1400s amid mixed Fed cues, geopolitics
item.description: The EUR/USD pair holds steady above the 1.1450 level during the Asian session on Thursday and consolidates its strong gains registered over the past two days, to the highest level since June 18.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Declines below 113.50, while maintaining bullish near‑term structure
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 113.45 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Verbal intervention from Japanese authorities provides some support to the Japanese Yen (JPY) against the Australian Dollar (AUD).

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah weakens as higher oil import costs stretch the trade balance
item.description: USD/IDR gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 18,100 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The pair holds ground as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces downward pressure as surging oil import costs stretch the nation's trade balance and stoke inflation.

item.title: Senior BoJ official: Delay in adjustment amid high inflation risk could trigger economic downturn
item.description: Senior officials from the Bank of Japan (BoJ) said on Thursday that a delay in stimulus adjustment amid high inflation risk could trigger an economic downturn.

item.title: Swiss Franc holds losses as US Dollar recovers on Middle East tensions
item.description: USD/CHF inches lower after opening at a bullish gap, remaining in positive territory and trading around 0.8060 during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: South Korean Won edges up against US Dollar as BoK hikes interest rates
item.description: The South Korean Won (KRW) reflects broader strength against the US Dollar (USD) as the Bank of Korea (BoK) delivers its first interest rate hike in three-and-a-half years, raising rates by 25 basis points (bps) to 2.75%.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Positions near ascending triangle top around 186.00
item.description: EUR/JPY depreciates after three days of gains, trading around 185.90 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The currency cross is retaining a constructive bullish bias as it holds above both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: United States Dollar Index struggles near 100.50, multi-week low amid fading Fed hike bets
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, is seen consolidating around the 100.50 region during the Asian session on Thursday, close to the nearly four-week low touched the previous day.

item.title: Japanese Yen strengthens on intervention warning, cooling US inflation
item.description: The USD/JPY pair loses ground to near 162.15 during the Asian trading hours on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) after verbal intervention from Japanese authorities.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $57.00 amid Middle East tensions
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around $57.00 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Thursday. The price of the non-yielding white metal faces significant challenges as rising US-Iran tensions boost oil prices and spark fresh inflation concerns.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama: Ready to take appropriate action on currency anytime as needed
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Thursday that the authorities are ready to take appropriate action on currency anytime as needed.

item.title: British Pound weakens below 1.3550 on renewed US strikes on Iran
item.description: The GBP/USD pair declines to near 1.3530 during the early Asian session on Thursday. The British Pound (GBP) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) as renewed conflict and shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz have reignited energy-driven inflation risks.

item.title: Canadian Dollar consolidates near four-week top vs USD; elevated oil prices favor bulls
item.description: The USD/CAD pair is seen oscillating in a range during the Asian session on Thursday and consolidating its recent losses to a four-week low, touched the previous day.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7909 vs. 6.7910 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Thursday at 6.7909 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7910 and 6.7577 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains subdued as Consumer Inflation Expectations fall in July
item.description: AUD/USD loses ground after two days of gains, trading around 0.7000 during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar drops as Middle East conflict escalates
item.description: NZD/USD inches lower after two days of gains, trading around 0.5840 during the Asian hours on Thursday. Traders are adopting a highly cautious stance ahead of Friday’s looming June food inflation data, which follows a sharp acceleration in figures back in May.
